## What the document establishes

The Bureau of Political-Military Affairs issued a congressional notification on August 21, 2026, identified as Transmittal #26-92. The record says the State Department approved a possible Foreign Military Sale to the Government of Italy for Guidance Section Single Variant Air-to-Air Advanced Precision Kill Weapon System-II and related equipment. [United States Department of State](https://www.state.gov/releases/bureau-of-political-military-affairs/2026/08/italy-guidance-section-single-variant-air-to-air-advanced-precision-kill-weapon-system-ii/). It identifies Italy’s request as 5,031 Guidance Sections Single Variant Air-to-Air Advanced Precision Kill Weapon System-II WGU 59B/B. [United States Department of State](https://www.state.gov/releases/bureau-of-political-military-affairs/2026/08/italy-guidance-section-single-variant-air-to-air-advanced-precision-kill-weapon-system-ii/). The document assigns the possible sale an estimated total cost of $364 million. [United States Department of State](https://www.state.gov/releases/bureau-of-political-military-affairs/2026/08/italy-guidance-section-single-variant-air-to-air-advanced-precision-kill-weapon-system-ii/).

The notification links four elements in one official record: the approving department, the requesting government, the requested quantity and the estimated value. Its approval language therefore does not, by itself, establish a concluded agreement, a contract award, a completed transaction, delivery or operational use. The $364 million figure should likewise be read as the estimated total cost attached to the possible sale, not as proof that this amount has been spent, received or booked. ## What would establish the next phase
